rows.text: # Adaptation-dependent absence deficit — 2026-09-26

**ACCEPTED / LOCAL DISPOSITION — no owner ruling required.**
Version `absence-deficit-component/0.1-candidate`. North Star9 and Brief12.9 clause8
require an absence deficit distinct from tolerance, cue association and expectation.
The accepted BODY ownership contract already distinguishes REG as target/reference
owner from current body truth. This instantiates that distinction; no new ontology,
psychological edge or public authority is introduced. Counters1400/0.

Reuse unchanged firstTraceModel and adaptation-input/0.31-candidate. Four actual
exposure occurrences at2..5 carry count0 or1. They acquire regulatory displacement
D through accepted phase110/140 transitions. Read only root302/field3 at the exact
RegulatoryAdaptationKey(character,variable); absence is zero. No tolerance,
sensitization or accumulated-load substitution. This fixture uses positive D0..10;
the general signed domain is neither retired nor claimed.

In a later independent world diagnostic, the immutable authored reference R0=50
is distinct from externally fixed current baseline x=50 and current physical
support s in[0,10]. The harness checks the source's exact constant50 reference and
zero rate. The effective reference is R=R0+D, current level y=x+s. Deficit gap is
max(0,R-y). No reference value is used as a replenished reserve. Physical support
is an exogenous challenge input, not an inferred expectation or selected action.
It does not itself update ADAPT. Each prefix starts a fresh independent challenge;
challenge results never feed the public source run. x is also varied to48 in an
ordinary-shortfall control, separating adaptation-dependent excess from baseline lack.
Three world-only candidate laws, committed before execution:

* LinearGap: response=gap/10.
* ThresholdGap: response=0 if gap<=2, otherwise (gap-2)/10.
* FixedReference: effective reference=R0; response=max(0,R0-y)/10.

FixedReference ablates use of acquired displacement but retains all acquired state.
ThresholdGap is a serious dead-band alternative, not a mutation test. Exact rational
arithmetic; x in[40,60], x+s<=70, R0=50, D in[0,10]. Response is a research-side
physical discrepancy index, not urgency, experienced distress or a new Need meter.
No sensor, evidence, belief, motive or action reads this result.

Freeze Model/Run/Experiment/Comparison identities and source hashes before the
matrix. For each law run acquired/naive absent, acquired/naive support4, spaced
exposure, ordinary shortfall for acquired/naive, unrelated variable key, and
non-displacement-initial-state control. Other leaves begin at2 while D stays0.
Same absence with matched x must differ after acquisition under intact laws;
support4 must remove the final acquired gap while D stays4. At D1/2 the dead-band
alternative disagrees with LinearGap. Zero-count events do not reset adaptation.
Replay every complete public save prefix and challenge, including terminal prefixes.
Independently cross-check exact arithmetic and source reference declaration.

MEC003/EXP002 preserve physical state/reference/effect distinctions. No reserve
clipping, learning or intent port is needed; EXP001/MEC019 and identity feedback
remain separate controls. Existing BODY sensors and public receiving qualifications
remain prior evidence, not new qualification here. No historical formula import.

RO008/010/011/015/019/020 preserve general regulatory dynamics, sensing, recovery,
distress, craving, learned relief and actual compensatory behavior. No general
withdrawal biology or whole addiction claim. RO021 historical gate remains mandatory.
Reopen for those claims or proposed reduction. No existing state is retired.

rows.text:
The controlled receiving opportunity exists at2..7 and14..21, absent at1/8 and
through the actual8-to14 gap. A boolean admitted context cue is false throughout,
or true after the gap in AlternateCue. These are explicit bounded perceptual inputs,
not learned segmentation. At1 an explicit positive reward report initializes belief
and a practice goal is adopted, active2, expiry22. At8 an explicit negative report
corrects reward belief, separately from the unavailable opportunity. No absence is
counted as a negative observation. Maintained keeps the goal; Withdrawn retires it;

Options are practice/idle if reward belief is positive or same-cue habit strength
is at least1/2, otherwise idle only. A goal supplies reasons, not automatic option
availability. Derived folds history; Stored reads an exactly maintained fold cache;
ExplicitBeliefOnly ignores history for availability; ScheduledOnly admits practice
whenever the source supplies an opportunity; EraseHistory clears acquired history
at8 as a destructive comparison model. All preserve the separate reward belief and
goal ledger. Every model keeps its original raw admitted journal except EraseHistory.
An empty or lost observation does not append a row.

to their desired practice/idle direction. Source observer-safe standing is the
existing trunc(1000*s) fine modifier, with opposite sign for rest. The practice
association to the source commitment channel is controlled, not learned semantics.
With no active reasons, the HABIT neutral-policy analogue samples uniformly among
available options; a singleton is automatic. This is distinct from the biological
NoActiveReasons policy. It uses the actual LONG actor, fixed routine tie-purpose,
root200+instant and original seed. Active reason draws use200+instant with distinct
purposes. HABIT observation occurrences are unsigned200+instant in namespace1155.
Neither cue strength nor history creates reward valence or a reason by itself.

rows.text: # Relapse after goal-supported adjustment — 2026-09-26

ACCEPTED / LOCAL DISPOSITION. `relapse-experiment/0.1-candidate`.
Use unchanged `control-public/0.2-candidate`, its seven frozen models and public
factory. No new law, source grammar, allocation or authority. Counters1400/0.
Architecture Control -> OptionGeneration and retained habit already authorize the
experiment. Behavioral adaptation here means adjustment to an adopted withholding
goal with actual repeated withholding; it is not learned control or biological recovery.

Eight instants: observed positive target practices1..3 acquire history and reward
belief; instruction3 adopts withholding at140. Reminder4 maintains the goal.
Free opportunities4/5/6 have spare control capacity and must actually execute idle.
At7 a neutral visible workspace card consumes the spare operation slot while the
goal remains retained and maintained. The same learned target can return through
ordinary reasons/dice and actual execution. At8 remove the card; inhibition and
idle must recover without deleting history. Keep skill1, identity0 and body
adaptation0. No post-training outcome observation in main; no new learning explains
the transient return. No physiological absence diagnostic enters cognition.

Freeze all seed0..7 main/noLoad pairs; do not select only seeds that return target.
Report all action sequences and exact distribution evidence. The noLoad comparator
must sustain idle4..8. A main seed with no return remains a valid negative outcome,
not a failed setup. The bounded witness requires at least one actual return at7,
with earlier idle4..6 and restored idle8, while the goal remains active throughout.
At7 the full appraisal and retained/maintained goal must equal noLoad. Neutral card
must add no motive; learned history remains fixed. Exact balanced target/idle reasons
are inherited, not a new relapse probability law. This is a transient lapse/return
witness, not necessarily sustained resumed use or a clinical relapse definition.

Preserve six nonbaseline model settings at seed7: Linear learning plus
NoInhibition/LoadBlind/RetainedEqualsMaintained/EraseHistory/NoHistory. Controls:
other cue at7, unseen training, no goal, negative reward information at6, hidden
reward changes, explicit goal retirement at6, lost maintenance at7, denied card7.
Also test RetainedEqualsMaintained under lost maintenance. Exact scope31 public runs
and279 whole-prefix checks, if all inputs pass the unchanged grammar. All seven
ModelIdentities must equal the original CONTROL plan; freeze new RunIdentities,
ExperimentIdentity and ComparisonCase before execution. Preserve original model
and closure source hashes. Save restoration checks the full original save, complete
snapshot, observer view and next continuation including terminal no-op.

MEC011/EXP003/004 preserve cue access versus filtering, MEC012..017/019 actual
reasons/dice/intent/expression/execution, MEC020 active goal lifecycle. Identity
feedback and physical adaptation remain separate controls. No source imports from
reference/, historical retirement or new generic Relapse state. Negative observed
reward may change expectation without deleting history. Retired goal is a separate
explanation from a lapse against a still-maintained goal.

RO008/010/011/012/015/019/020 retain natural recovery, acquired inhibitory skill,
body/urge/goal integration, unavailable actions, compulsive escalation, sustained
relapse and broader source/seed coverage. RO021 remains mandatory before exit.
